create_bert_tiny_model: create a tiny BERT model with custom config and save it to a directory
test_BertEncoder_forward: test the BertEncoder class by loading a model and encoding input_ids into sentence representations
test_HFEncoder_forward: test the HFEncoder class by loading a model and encoding input_ids into sentence representations
run_test_BertEncoder: run the TestBertEncoder unit tests to verify BERT encoder loads and produces correct output shapes
run_test_HFEncoder: run the TestHFEncoder unit tests to verify HuggingFace encoder loads and produces correct output shapes
